_rule: Written 2026-11-11 ~21:40 UTC, before any Kev score exists for these updates. Human gold = Open Terms Archive memos (opentermsarchive.org/en/memos, 107 memos, independent contributors) on a ToS or Privacy Policy of a pga-versions platform, matched to pga-versions 'Record new changes' commits of the same document within +-10 days (eval/memos_matched.json). Targets are bank.json (v2) indices a correct tool should move, chosen by me from the memo TITLE only. A memo is CAUGHT if, in any matched real update, any target question is flagged (|dp| >= .3) or ranked in that update's top 5. 'targets: []' = no bank question covers the change (coverage gap, counted separately, never as caught). 'broad' = a wholesale rewrite with no single target: caught if the update has >= 1 flag. Rewrites (> 80 changed paragraphs) are not scored and count as NOT caught.
